interface Chain {
  value: number;
  get(): this;
}
interface Named extends Chain { name: string }
class Item implements Named {
  value = 2;
  name = 'item';
  get(): this { return this; }
}
function keep<T extends Chain>(value: T): T { return value.get(); }
function keepNamed<T extends Chain & { name: string }>(value: T): string {
  return value.get().name;
}
function plain(value: Chain & { name: string }): string { return value.get().name; }
const value: Named = new Item();
console.log(value.get().name, keep(value).name, keepNamed(value), plain(value));
interface Fluent<T> {
  value: T;
  map(action: (item: this) => T): this;
}
interface FluentChild extends Fluent<number> { multiplier: number }
function next(item: FluentChild): FluentChild { return item.map(value => value.value * value.multiplier); }
